model_annotations.Bulgarian: The figure illustrates the change in sparsity ratio across different layers of an SDPA output, comparing the sparsity ratio before and after applying a gate mechanism. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," represents the layer number and ranges from 0 to 22, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. There are three distinct lines plotted on the graph. The first line, represented by a dashed blue line, corresponds to the "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03." It starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.2 at layer 0, decreases to a value near 0.0 by layer 3, and remains close to 0.0 for the rest of the layers. The second line, a dotted orange line, represents the "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44." This line begins at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.98 at layer 0, then decreases sharply to about 0.48 at layer 7, fluctuates between 0.2 and 0.45 from layer 10 to layer 21, and ends at a value of approximately 0.38 at layer 22. The third line, a solid green line, shows the "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33." It starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.2 at layer 14, and then slightly increases to a value of approximately 0.06 at layer 22.
model_annotations.Chinese: The graph displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three metrics: the sparsity ratio before gate application, the sparsity ratio after gate application, and the sparsity ratio after average gate application. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22 in integer steps, with no units specified. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The blue dashed line, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.18 at layer 0, decreases to a value near 0.01 at layer 10, and remains close to 0.01 for the remaining layers. The orange dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", begins at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.98 at layer 0, declines sharply to about 0.48 at layer 8, then fluctuates between approximately 0.18 and 0.42 for the remaining layers. The green dash-dotted line, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33", starts at a sparsity ratio of approximately 0.99 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.21 at layer 10, and continues to decline to approximately 0.06 at layer 22.
model_annotations.English: The plot displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-2, illustrating how sparsity changes before and after applying a gate mechanism. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 22 in increments of 5, while the y-axis shows the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. Three distinct lines are shown: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, which starts at approximately 0.2 and gradually decreases to around 0.01 by layer 22; an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after the gate, which begins at about 0.98 and generally declines to around 0.4, with noticeable fluctuations; and a green dash-dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate, which starts at 1.0 and decreases to approximately 0.07. The legend indicates that the average sparsity ratio before the gate is 0.03, after the gate is 0.44, and after the average gate is 0.33.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt den Sparsitätsverhältnis (Sparsity Ratio) des SDPA-Outputs für verschiedene Schichten bei einem Schwellenwert von 1e-2. Die x-Achse repräsentiert die Schicht (Layer) und ist linear skaliert mit Werten von 0 bis 22, wobei die Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 angegeben sind. Die y-Achse zeigt das Sparsitätsverhältnis, ebenfalls linear skaliert von 0.0 bis 1.0, mit Beschriftungen in Schritten von 0.2. Drei verschiedene Linien werden dargestellt: die blaue gestrichelte Linie, die das Sparsitätsverhältnis vor dem Gate darstellt, beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 0.2 bei Layer 0 und fällt bis zu einem Wert von etwa 0.02 bei Layer 22, wobei sie in den letzten Schichten nahezu konstant bleibt. Die orange gestrichelte Linie, die das Sparsitätsverhältnis nach dem Gate zeigt, beginnt bei etwa 0.95 bei Layer 0 und fällt bis zu einem Wert von etwa 0.35 bei Layer 22, wobei sie in den letzten Schichten Schwankungen aufweist. Die grüne durchgezogene Linie, die das Sparsitätsverhältnis nach dem Durchschnittsgate darstellt, beginnt bei etwa 1.0 bei Layer 0 und fällt bis zu einem Wert von etwa 0.05 bei Layer 22, wobei sie in den letzten Schichten ebenfalls Schwankungen aufweist.
